signature_fact_questions.evidence_note: Standards-required when the organisation type is humanitarian (19.21); sealed feedback/safeguarding wording present in both bands (Estimate).
signature_fact_questions.label: Estimate
signature_fact_questions.question_en: If this is a humanitarian post: what may be said publicly; and what safeguarding or do-no-harm limits apply to content?
signature_fact_questions.question_fr: Si ce poste est humanitaire: que peut-on dire publiquement; et quelles limites de sauvegarde ou de ne pas nuire s’appliquent au contenu?
signature_fact_questions.why_en: CHS do-no-harm and respectful communications sit in the accountability block; the chat asks rather than inventing copy rules.
signature_fact_questions.why_fr: Le CHS (ne pas nuire; communications respectueuses) relève du bloc de redevabilité; le chat demande au lieu d’inventer des règles de contenu.

signature_fact_questions.evidence_note: Advocacy wording in 7/15 high-specificity vs 2/5 lower; advocacy-initiative is a measured group (Estimate).
signature_fact_questions.label: Estimate
signature_fact_questions.question_en: What change; policy ask or campaign objective should the work advance?
signature_fact_questions.question_fr: Quel changement; demande politique ou objectif de campagne le travail doit-il faire avancer?
signature_fact_questions.why_en: Without an ask or objective; advocacy lines stay ornamental.
signature_fact_questions.why_fr: Sans demande ou objectif; les lignes de plaidoyer restent décoratives.

signature_fact_questions.evidence_note: Audience wording in 6/15 high-specificity sealed Option A vs 0/5 lower; audiences-communications is a measured group (Estimate).
signature_fact_questions.label: Estimate
signature_fact_questions.question_en: Who are the primary audiences for this post’s communications or advocacy?
signature_fact_questions.question_fr: Quels sont les publics prioritaires des communications ou du plaidoyer de ce poste?
signature_fact_questions.why_en: Audience is the signature fact that separates a real communications brief from channel filler.
signature_fact_questions.why_fr: Le public est le fait signature qui distingue un vrai brief communication d’un remplissage sur les canaux.

signature_fact_questions.evidence_note: Channel/media wording is common in both bands; kept because measured groups (media; social; newsletters; events) show it as core role content (Estimate).
signature_fact_questions.label: Estimate
signature_fact_questions.question_en: Which channels or products must the post deliver (for example press; social; newsletter; events)?
signature_fact_questions.question_fr: Quels canaux ou produits le poste doit-il livrer (par exemple presse; réseaux sociaux; newsletter; événements)?
signature_fact_questions.why_en: Candidates need the channel mix to judge craft skills and workload.
signature_fact_questions.why_fr: Les candidats ont besoin du mix de canaux pour juger des compétences et de la charge.

signature_fact_questions.evidence_note: Broad-layer languages fact is often missing from communications adverts; kept as a role signature check (Estimate; not from sealed specificity delta).
signature_fact_questions.label: Estimate
signature_fact_questions.question_en: Which languages must the post write or speak for public or partner communications?
signature_fact_questions.question_fr: Quelles langues le poste doit-il écrire ou parler pour les communications publiques ou partenaires?
signature_fact_questions.why_en: Language is a genuine requirement for communications posts and must not be left implied.
signature_fact_questions.why_fr: La langue est une exigence réelle pour les postes communication et ne doit pas rester implicite.
